nom: Cetaphil Sheer Mineral Face Liquid Drops SPF 50

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin mostly describe it as mattifying and non-greasy with no added shine, though one reviewer with oily skin found it made her face oily after just a few drops.
segments.dry: Reports from reviewers with dry skin conflict: one describes the formula as ideal and hydrating specifically for dry skin, while another with dry skin found it not hydrating at all and recommends moisturizing underneath first.
segments.sensitive: The large majority of reviewers with sensitive skin, including many managing rosacea, eczema, dermatitis or fungal acne, report no irritation and no breakouts, with several calling it the only sunscreen that has ever worked for their skin; a couple of reviewers report the opposite, describing burning, flushing, or bumps and swelling shortly after applying.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the sunscreen as hydrating or at least not drying, including on eczema-prone skin; a couple found it drying or not hydrating enough on its own, with one recommending moisturizer underneath.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers with rosacea, perioral dermatitis or general redness report using it without flare-ups or irritation, and one reviewer says the white cast itself visually tones down redness and neutralizes sallow tones once blended in.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports her acne spots fading with continued use, and another separately says it evens out skin tone; this is thin, isolated material.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers who describe themselves as acne-prone or breakout-prone consistently report no new breakouts and, in a couple of cases, improvement in existing acne; no reviewer reports it causing blemishes.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers describe the finish as non-greasy or mattifying, including several with oily skin; one reviewer with oily skin found it made her face oily when using just a few drops.

aspects.libelle: Strong white cast, worse on deeper skin tones
Wears well under makeup, no pilling
Runny formula, hard to control dispensing

extraits.texte: If I could rate zero stars I would. I bought this bc it states for sensitive skin. I used this for vacation the first day and after applying to my face within an hour my face was burning. I immediately washed it off and it actually burned my skin. I also had bumps and swelling to my neck. If your prone to other brand names that have done this don't use this product. I have used others and I had the same results. Not sure if there really is a product out there for really sensitive skin.

extraits.titre: It's really great for dry skin, but just dry skin
extraits.texte: The consistency is so hydrating and runny, it comes out of the bottle so fast lol, and it borders on greasy for anything less than a dry skin type. I wouldnt recommend if you plan on wearing under makeup.

extraits.titre: Amazing, but wish they had a tinted version
extraits.texte: When i first bought this, i thought it was horrible because it does leave you purple-ish at first but it takes awhile for it to sink into your skin. The texture is very watery, it will run down your fingers/ hands when it's out of the bottle but it makes it easy to spread. it is not hydrating so if you are a little bit on the dry skin type like me, it's best to moisturize prior to application. The packaging is great, the sunscreen doesn't come out unless squeezed and i have never had it leak. It is eczema friendly which is a plus as well. The only con I had to this is that i wish they had a tinted version!

Best sunscreen I have used! And for that price tag even better! I have oily skin and it doesn't make me more oily, it's very light weight and almost mattifying. It wears beautifully under make up! 10/10 recommend
I have a oily and acne prone skin love this mineral sunscreen its light weight and does not break me out. I hope cetaphil makes a tinted one with the same formula.

I've always had bad experiences with sunscreen and this is the first one that's hitting all the marks for me. I've been using it for a few months now and I feel like my skin has improved so much. My acne spots are fading. The sunscreen feels great on my skin, blends in really well, and doesn't pill under makeup! I have really sensitive skin so I was worried how it'd react to this, but its been loving it!

extraits.titre: The best mineral fluid I've used!
extraits.texte: The best mineral fluid I've used! I have a very sensitive skin, rosacea and dermatitis, so I was looking for a SPF product which won't irritate my skin or eyes and will give me a good protection during the day. I was surprised how lightweight the formula is! It doesn't whiten my skin a lot and absorbs quickly. I didn't even feel it on my face. I will be buying it again.

reserve: The most consequential and frequently reported issue, a white cast ranging from mild to severe depending on the user's skin tone rather than skin type, falls outside the categories used here and is captured only in the aspects list.
